name: Basile Aucourt
role: Long-stay patient, Ward Four, the General Hospital -- a harbour pilot from Taldor, on the far side of the world
designNotes:
Created 2026-09-29, extracted from his cast entry in canon/scenes/rest--general-hospital.json -- same process as tsubaki.json and imai.json, his ward-mates, formalized the same day. His cast entry needs its own `npcRef: "aucourt"` added in canon (then a story build) before the automatic token pipeline can place a hidden reference token for him.

ANCESTRY, Ingram's own request (2026-09-29): 'we have a lot of humans in the campaign so far so we've got work to do to bring the average around.' Kalo -- checked against data/campaign/ancestry-catalogue.json (`terrestrial: false`, a genuinely alien people, aquatic humanoids from a moon of Bretheda), not another Golarion-native pick like Imai's Ysoki. Chosen because it lands directly on what's already written about him: a man who has spent thirty years reading tides, currents and sandbanks by feel, still homesick for a country on the far side of the world he never went back to. Per Brack (shop-boss.json)'s established precedent, an alien on this base draws no stares any more -- he's simply been here thirty years.

His real statblock is still a placeholder in the scene file: "Proposed: level 1, a harbour pilot, non-combat. Made with Ingram once the NPC generator exists." Not carried into this file's `statblock` field for that reason.

No socialProfile.facts authored: his one willNotDiscuss item (whether he'll go back to work) has an empty `coercible: []` in the source -- no authored reveal trigger, so nothing invented here rather than making one up.
status: established and voiced (the General Hospital haunt is built and playable) -- third haunt regular formalized into a real npc file
